title: Maine attic portrait believed to be Rembrandt sells for $1.41 million after $15,000 estimate
summary_full: A portrait by the Dutch master Rembrandt was auctioned for $1.41 million after being discovered in Maine. The painting, titled Portrait of a Young Girl, remained in a farmhouse attic for decades. Auctioneer Kaja Veilleux identified its connection to Rembrandt during an estate visit. Experts suggest its true value could be as high as $15 million if authenticated.
